result.title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
result.summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

AI.brief_summary: SPLICE 针对长程 agent RL 中「整组轨迹全失败、零奖励」导致组相对优势失去梯度的问题，在线从当前策略的失败轨迹中选 splice 点并生成若干有界选项，用重复续写估计各选项价值，把正估计转成回报加权的局部目标来更新策略，并在 SWE-bench Verified 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上对比 GRPO 与全轨迹引导基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部片段 + 分支续写价值估计」的构造可能为 latent 推理轨迹的分段监督、贡献分配以及继续/停止决策提供借鉴线索，但工作限于纯文本 agent、缺少视觉状态，可供核查该局部目标能否用于内部推理状态的价值估计。
